t: You're at York Road, a disused station on the Piccadilly line in Kings Cross. Its entrance is at the corner of York Road and Bingfield Street, and it lies between King's Cross St Pancras and Caledonian Road. It's closed to passengers. The architect Leslie Green designed it. He is best known for his Underground stations of the early 1900s, with oxblood red glazed faïence blocks, pillars, semi-circular windows on the first floor, and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
